title: The Quran: Surah 95, at-Tin (The Fig)
author: Tradução inglesa de Talal Itani (ClearQuran)
tradition: Texto sagrado do Islão, século VII
intro: Lição sobre a Surata 95. O texto inglês é a tradução de Talal Itani, reproduzida sem alterações; as notas de língua, perguntas, discussão e escrita são material pedagógico separado, baseado apenas no que o próprio texto diz.

source.title: Quran English Translation: Clear, Pure, Easy to Read Modern English
source.edition: Edition A (uses the word 'Allah' to refer to the Creator)

questions.q: According to verse 4, how did He create man?
questions.why: O versículo 4 diz: 'We created man in the best design.'
'Design' é a forma ou o desenho.

questions.q: Verse 5 says 'the lowest of the low'. What contrast does it make with verse 4?
options: A contrast between day and night
A contrast between the best design and the lowest of the low
questions.why: O versículo 4 diz 'the best design' e o versículo 5 diz 'the lowest of the low'.

questions.q: What kind of sentences are verses 7 and 8?
questions.why: Os versículos 7 e 8 acabam com ponto de interrogação.

questions.q: Which sentence best sums up verses 4 to 6?
options: Man is created and then forgotten
Man travels to a safe land
Man is created in the best design and reduced to the lowest, except those who believe and do right, who have a reward without end
questions.why: Os versículos 4 a 6 juntam a criação, a queda e a excepção.

B2.discussion: Verses 4 and 5 present a strong contrast. Can you think of a story, a film or a text that uses a contrast like this?
B2.writing: Write 80 to 100 words: Say what the passage tells us about man.

questions.q: Which three things are named in verses 1 to 3?
options: The fig and the olive, Mount Sinai, and this safe land
The sun, the moon and the stars
The sea, the river and the lake
The city, the road and the house
questions.why: Os versículos 1 a 3 nomeiam o figo e a azeitona, o Monte Sinai e esta terra segura.

questions.q: In verse 6, 'Except those who believe and do righteous deeds' introduces:
options: a group left out of what verse 5 says
questions.why: 'Except' marca quem fica de fora do que o versículo 5 diz.

questions.q: What does the word 'Except' tell us about verse 5?
options: That it does not apply to the group named in verse 6
That it is about the past only
questions.why: A excepção do versículo 6 limita o versículo 5.

questions.q: Which description of the passage's movement is best supported?
options: A list of laws, then a prayer
Things named by 'And' (1 to 3), a statement about man (4 and 5), an exception (6), two questions (7 and 8)
questions.why: Cada grupo de versículos tem uma função diferente.

questions.q: Which description of the last two verses is best supported?
options: Two questions that ask the reader to think about rejecting and about wisdom
questions.why: O versículo 7 pergunta por que rejeitar e o versículo 8 pergunta 'Is Allah not the Wisest of the wise?'.

C1.discussion: The passage moves from named places and trees to a statement about man and then to questions. How does this order prepare the reader for the questions at the end?
C1.writing: Write 120 to 150 words: Explain how verse 6 changes the meaning of verse 5.

glossary: By the fig and the olive
created man in the best design
criámos o homem na melhor forma

options: Is Allah not the Wisest of the wise?
questions.why: O versículo 8 diz: 'Is Allah not the Wisest of the wise?'

questions.q: 'The lowest of the low' and 'the Wisest of the wise' share a structure. Which?
options: A superlative built by repeating the word: X of the X
questions.why: As duas expressões repetem a palavra: 'low... low', 'wise... wise'.

questions.q: Verse 7 asks 'So why do you still reject the religion?' What does 'still' suggest?
options: That the rejection continues despite what was said before
That the reader has not heard anything
That the question is a joke
questions.why: 'Still' sugere que a rejeição continua apesar do que vem antes.

questions.q: Which pair of verses forms a contrast?
questions.why: O versículo 4 diz 'the best design' e o versículo 5 diz 'the lowest of the low'.

questions.q: Which description of the passage's progression is best supported?
options: Three things named (1 to 3), the creation and fall of man with an exception (4 to 6), and two closing questions (7 and 8)
questions.why: Cada bloco tem uma função clara.

C2.discussion: The passage ends with two questions instead of a statement. What does closing with questions do to the way the reader finishes the text?
C2.writing: Write 150 to 200 words: Analyse how the eight verses build towards the final questions, referring to specific words.
